description: Contains unit tests for runtime versioning and strategy change scenarios in an Orleans-based distributed system. Uses Xunit for testing various version compatibility and selector strategies in dynamic silo deployments.

classes.name: RuntimeStrategyChangeTests
classes.description: A test suite validating runtime strategy changes for version compatibility and interface selection in Orleans silos.

methods.name: ChangeCompatibilityStrategy
methods.description: Tests switching the compatibility strategy during runtime and its effect on grain activation and versioning.

methods.name: ChangeVersionSelectorStrategy
methods.description: Tests changing the version selector strategy at runtime to influence grain activation versions.

methods.name: ChangeDefaultVersionCompatibilityStrategy
methods.description: Verifies default compatibility strategy impacts upon starting new silos and subsequent versioning behavior.

methods.name: ChangeDefaultVersionSelectorStrategy
methods.description: Validates default selector strategy alterations influence subsequent grain activation versions.
